first_principles_boundary.intended_runtime_action: a future cheap regional signal may only advance or delay the next complete transformer anchor
first_principles_boundary.note: The pilot spends extra full-DiT calls only to label causal time steps and regions. No result may justify serving unless a separate cheap proxy passes a newly registered holdout.

phase_1_temporal_localization.shadow_trace: At each naturally skipped step, compute and save the true transformer output on the unchanged candidate pre-step latent, but advance the original predicted output.
phase_1_temporal_localization.intervention: Replay from the identical seed and candidate state; at exactly one skipped step replace the complete prediction with its saved true output, then resume the unmodified cache policy.
phase_1_temporal_localization.selection: Rank skipped steps independently for each failed request by VQAScore repair gain and retain at most two positive-gain steps.
phase_1_temporal_localization.continue_if: Each failed request has at least one single-step intervention with positive repair gain and reduced VQAScore harm.
phase_1_temporal_localization.stop_if: Either failed request has no positive single-step repair gain; report the damage as temporally distributed under this intervention and stop the spatial phase.

phase_2_spatial_localization.layout: 4x4 equal regions over the 64x64 FLUX token grid
phase_2_spatial_localization.intervention: At one phase-1-selected step, load the saved true output produced on the identical pre-step latent and replace exactly one region of the predicted output; all later steps use the unmodified cache policy.
phase_2_spatial_localization.controls: Run the same selected-step regional interventions on the six frozen pass controls only after both failures pass the causal-concentration gate.

routing_decision.spatial_gate_passes: Proceed to a separate prompt-conditioned cheap-signal protocol; this pilot alone cannot add SP/TP voting or enable acceleration.
routing_decision.temporal_gate_fails: Stop spatial voting work and investigate global or multi-step prompt-risk controls.
routing_decision.spatial_gate_fails: Do not implement rank voting; the VQA damage is not sufficiently concentrated under the registered coarse intervention.
